title: TX queue completion can resolve non-head entries without removing them
description: Post-fix correctness review: TxQueue.complete(non_head, success=True) resolves True before head identity check but leaves the entry queued; fail(non_head) and signal_all_pending(False) can also leave terminally resolved entries eligible to transmit. Make exact queue mutation and reservation result atomic; wrong/non-head completion must no-op/raise unresolved, and no False-resolved entry may later transmit. Extend warning tests with reservation assertions.
